fixed.explanation: The shared serializer has no Map/Set cases, so they fall into the generic object branch and become empty objects. I added an opt-in `structuredClone` flag to serializeAsCallArgument that encodes Map as {m} and Set as {s}. The parser always understands these keys. StorageScript enables the flag, so evaluation results are unchanged.
